What is this seven deadly sins test website?

Seven Little Sins is an independent seven deadly sins test website: one free quiz, 21 statements, seven independent scores, and an illustrated result card you can save or share. Everything runs in your browser — there is no account, no email gate, and no server storing your answers. It is a small entertainment project built around the traditional seven names, not a clinical or diagnostic tool.

WHY THIS EXISTS

A familiar habit,
with a little personality.

The message you want to reply to immediately. The awkward task you keep moving to tomorrow. The friend’s milestone that quietly changes your own goals. This project starts with ordinary situations like those.

The seven traditional names give us a shared vocabulary; the questions and illustrated characters give them a playful, everyday setting. You do not need a religious background or knowledge of an anime series to take the quiz.

Our aim is to offer a short moment of reflection and a conversation starter. You can recognize a habit without making it your whole identity.

THE EXPERIENCE

A small quiz.
A whole cast of possibilities.

21 original statements

Everyday scenes cover seven tendencies, with three equally weighted questions for each. There are no right answers or paid results.

Seven independent scores

The complete profile stays in view. Equal highest scores share the spotlight, and a result never invents a winner to break a tie.

Original character cards

The Main Character, the Tiny Volcano, the Cozy Strategist, and the rest of the cast were created for Seven Little Sins.

Optional ways to explore

Read a character guide, try a reflection prompt, download a character PNG, or choose to share a result link.

HOW WE PRESENT THE PROJECT

Clear about the numbers.
Careful with the labels.

We explain the calculation rather than hiding it behind a personality label. See how the scoring works for a worked example, while the results guide explains single leaders, tied results, and evenly matched profiles.

Our guide to the seven deadly sins separates the traditional list from our modern interpretations and links to a source for that list. The individual guides use everyday examples and distinguish a tendency from ordinary experiences such as confidence, ambition, attraction, anger, and rest.

The site is published under the Seven Little Sins project name. We do not present the quiz as expert clinical advice or claim professional credentials for it. Questions about the project and corrections to its content are welcome through our contact page.

WHAT THIS QUIZ IS FOR

A prompt for reflection.

These are original entertainment questions, not a validated psychological scale. The result cannot diagnose a condition, establish a fixed personality type, or rank your moral worth. We have not established population norms or validated thresholds for the scores.

Seven Little Sins is an independent quiz, not the IDRlabs test. Its original characters are not characters from The Seven Deadly Sins anime. The score descriptions and optional challenges should be read in that context.

YOUR QUESTIONS HELP

A little feedback
is always useful.

If something is unclear, a page is difficult to use, or a detail needs correcting, tell us which page and what you noticed. The contact page explains what information is useful to include.

For questions about quiz storage, Analytics, or result sharing, read the privacy notice or email xsanmei1@gmail.com.
